name: guardrail-notice
description: Shows a card in the chat and an entry above the prompt when a PreToolUse hook refuses a tool call, so work blocked on you is not missed. It only observes: it never blocks, changes or delays a call.

patterns.title: Extra refusal patterns
patterns.description: Name the hook behind a refusal. Each entry is Label=text, or bare text (named 'hook'). The text is matched as a plain case-insensitive substring of the first 2000 characters of the refusal's message, and is checked before the built-in patterns. Start the text with re: to use a regular expression instead, such as Policy=re:^Blocked \w+ policy. A re: expression with a nested quantifier, such as (a+)+, is rejected, but the check is partial: other shapes, such as (a|aa)+, are accepted and can take exponential time on a long message, which stalls the next tool call's hooks until it ends, so write re: patterns with care. Everything before the first = is the label, so text containing = must be written Label=text. A rejected or invalid entry is reported once in the transcript. Every hook refusal is shown either way.

toast.title: Toast on refusal
toast.description: Also raise a toast when a hook refuses a tool call.
